title: A separated morphism that is locally an open immersion and is generically injective on irreducible components is an open immersion
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter varieties.tex, section on finding affine opens
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterizes open immersions among separated morphisms that are open immersions on an open covering and whose restriction to the generic points of the irreducible components of the source is injective. The proof specializes: two points x, x' with a common image y are pushed up from a specialization y_0 -> y of a generic point of a component of Y to specializations x_0 -> x, x'_0 -> x'; the generic points coincide by hypothesis, and separatedness identifies x = x' (proof lines 8904-8909). H2: the simultaneous lifting of specializations and the use of separatedness to compare the two lifts is the non-routine step.
